The products they manufacture are safety products such as helmets through recycled plastic. Plastic is widely used in India and is available in abundance, making it a suitable material for helmet production. Additionally, by using recycled ABS plastic, we can contribute to reducing plastic waste in the environment. The end products which are manufactured are in-turn donated to deserving candidates. Thus, your participation in this program will not only empower the underprivileged but also ensure that the products which they manufacture from recycled plastic will directly benefit organisations and communities that are most deserving and are in the need of them.
